name: Victorian student concession (myki)
summary: Half-price fares on Victorian public transport for full-time undergraduate and TAFE students.
who: International students can get a separate International Student Travel Pass.
how: Apply for a Victorian Student Pass.
You need a Transport Victoria student ID or an approved ID from your institution. Ask your institution whether its ID is approved.
International students buy the International Student Travel Pass online at internationalstudent.ptv.vic.gov.au.
catches: Postgraduate and part-time students can't get the student concession.
Carry your student ID whenever you travel on the concession.
